jcr:title: TPX HD
jcr:description: Discover the comprehensive corded solution featuring both high- and low-speed burring and powerful torque, expanding whatˇs possible for total joint, extremities and high-speed cases. With specialized attachments, a full breadth of cutting accessories and a motor powerful enough to cut through metal and cement, TPX HD prepares you for everyday cases and challenging revisions.

largeheadline.line1: Purpose built power
largeheadline.line2: TPX HD: equipping you with the power, speed and control you need to handle your cases with confidence

Introducing TPX HD: the comprehensive small bone solution with premium power, customizable control and specialized attachments capable of cutting through metal and bone cement. 

Featuring high torque, and both high- and low-speed burring , TPX HD is designed to empower you.

text.text:
A better barrier

TPX HD has an increased housing size** of 0.93”, designed as a barrier for motor heat when running at high speeds.

text_copy.text:
Improved metal cutting and expanded indications for bone cement cutting

TPX HD allows for faster, more efficient performance when cutting through metal.** In addition, 11 cutting accessories feature expanded indications for bone cement cutting and removal.

Enhanced ergonomics

With a shorter handpiece length and improved grip, TPX HD was designed for surgeon comfort.

text_copy_copy.text:
Attachments for added specialization

With three attachment lengths, a PROStep 5:1 reducer and new specialized metal-cutting capabilities, TPX HD empowers you— from MIS techniques to challenging revisions.

text_copy.text:
Visibility in confined spaces

The tapered design of the attachments offers a lower profile for better visibility to the working site, while the long straight attachment allows better access for bone cement removal and bone shaping.‡

Variable speed and torque

Customize how TPX HD responds and feels via I.D. Touch software within Stryker’s CORE 2 Console. This allows you to control how your electric drill responds when pressure is applied—from low to high sensitivity—redefining performance to your liking.

text.text:
Seamless integration with TPX

TPX HD is compatible with existing foot pedals, the TPX HD handswitch, the CORE 2 Console, and the broad range of OI cutting accessories.†

largeheadline_124820.line1:
Total Joint and Trauma

Prepares you to perform at your best
largeheadline_124820.line2: With specialized metal cutting attachments and a full breadth of cutting accessories, TPX HD equips you with the power and control you need to handle your cases with confidence.

text_copy.text:
Built to be even more versatile

From everyday procedures to MIS techniques and difficult revisions, TPX HD is designed to empower you. 

  • Faster, more efficient performance when cutting through metal**
  • Three new metal cutting accessories
  • Expanded indications for bone cement cutting and removal on 11 cutting accessories
  • 14 cm long straight attachment allows better access for bone cement removal and bone shaping!

Torque you can trust

From bone to bone cement to metal, TPX HD brings the power you need to confidently handle everyday cases and challenging revisions.

text_copy_copy.text:
A better barrier

An increased housing size** provides better motor heat shielding when operating at high speeds.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Customizable control

Featuring both high- and low-speed burring, TPX HD puts you in control. Whether you need power, speed or finesse, TPX HD prepares you to perform.

largeheadline_124820.line1:
Foot and Ankle

Torque you can trust
largeheadline_124820.line2: With customizable speed and torque, TPX HD provides the power and control you need for foot and ankle procedures, including MIS.

text_copy.text:
Power at your pace

Featuring high torque and both high- and low-speed burring, TPX HD puts you in control. Whether you need power, speed or finesse, TPX HD prepares you to perform.

text_copy_copy.text:
PROStep MIS reducer

Compatible with straight shank and j-notch burs, the PROStep MIS reducer is designed to increase torque and reduce speed by a 5:1 ratio.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Versatility on demand

With specialized attachments including a short straight attachment and a full breadth of cutting accessories, TPX HD prepares you to perform at your best.

text_copy.text:
Torque that powers through

TPX HD brings the power you trust from Stryker in a compact handpiece for faster, more-efficient performance for foot and ankle procedures, minimally invasive approaches and when cutting through metal.**

text_copy_copy.text:
Enhanced ergonomics

With a shorter handpiece length and improved grip, TPX HD was designed for surgeon comfort. The shorter length also results in less interference with the mini C arm.

largeheadline_124820.line1:
Oral and Maxillofacial (OMF)

Proven power at the high speeds you need
largeheadline_124820.line2: TPX HD equips you with the control, visibility and versatility even at high speed to do more with your OMF procedures.

text_copy.text:
Power at your pace

TPX HD's customizable high-speed burring and adjustable torque put you in control.

text_copy_copy.text:
Improved visibility

With a shorter handpiece length and a streamlined, tapered attachment design, TPX HD offers a lower profile and improved visibility to the working site.

text_copy.text:
A better barrier

An increased housing size** provides better motor heat shielding when operating at high speeds.

text_copy_copy.text:
Versatility on demand

TPX HD is designed to cover the procedural needs for OMF and dental use. With specialized attachments and a full breadth of cutting accessories, TPX HD prepares you to perform at your best.
